crm_notes:
Overview: enterprise dev tools org building an internal code assistant for regulated trading desks. Need a private-hosted copilot that can be pinned to vetted model versions, stream incremental tokens to IDEs with <50ms interactive latency target, and retain audit trails for compliance.

Key contact(s): Todd Rivera (CTO), Maya Lin (Head of Platform), Priya Raman (technical SE). AE Marcus Heller running deal.

Recent timeline:
- 2024-07-18: Lead created from webinar (interest form).
- 2024-08-01: Intro call; high-level requirements captured (VPC, SSO, retention).
- 2024-09-10: Architecture deep-dive with platform team; discussed private control plane. Fireflies: ff_20241107_9876 (see transcript stub).
- 2024-10-12: Security questionnaire submitted (500+ Qs). SEC-1198 opened for clarifications.
- 2024-11-07: Product demo focused on low-latency streaming and kernel selection; asked about quantization and model pinning. ff_20241107_9876.
- 2024-11-15: Internal cost modeling workshop; Redwood Optimize recommendations requested. ff_20241115_1042.

Technical requirements (shorthand):
- workload: IDE plugin (VSCode + internal IDE), pair-programming and background completion.
- latency: sub-50ms token streaming for completion + <150ms for pair session handshake.
- throughput: 200 concurrent devs w/ spikes to 600 during release sprints.
- models: want Llama-family distilled + occasional gated larger models; strict model-version pinning per team.
- fallback: automated downgrade to smaller quantized model within same family on capacity pressure.
- caching: prefix/KV cache mandatory for repo-aware completions.
- observability: token-level cost, per-route latency, trace to PR/commit id.

Security/compliance notes:
- Must support SAML SSO + SCIM for provisioning.
- Audit logs retained 7 years for regulated teams; retention controls must be configurable per org unit.
- KMS integration required for envelope encryption; on-prem HSM optional for highest-risk teams.
- Data residency: primary EU for EMEA teams, NA for US trading teams.
- Air-gapped PoC considered for most-sensitive teams (longer procurement).

Commercial/Procurement notes:
- Procurement prefers annual reserved capacity contract for predictable latency during trading hours.
- Budget flagged: $250k-$750k ARR. Procurement kickoff planned after security sign-off.

Next actions (short):
- Deliver updated DPA + residency clause (legal).
- Run 2-week private VPC PoC with VSCode plugin instrumented for token-level metrics (SE: Priya).
- Security team to complete SAML/SCIM integration tests and provide SCIM endpoints.
- Cost walkthrough with Finance and Redwood Optimize recommendations.

Quoted lines from CTO: "We cannot allow model drift in production — pinning is non-negotiable. Latency is a hard constraint for pair-programming."
